label: charts
quotes: A UI component module that renders a tabular data display named DataTable, with no further functional detail recorded.
The Legend module provides a UI component that renders a legend explaining the colors, symbols, or categories used in an associated chart or visualization.
Provides scale construction logic used to map data values to visual coordinates for chart organisms like dumbbell, heatmap, line, and scatter charts.
The Tones module defines a set of tone values used elsewhere in the project, with no further requirements documented yet.
Documented the Use number format module, a hook providing number formatting logic for consumption by UI components.
